ValidationRule.description: V-OUT-04: Blocks Student Credit Check stage if Partner Transcript has not been received. Partner Transcript Received must be checked before the case can reach Student Credit Check.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Outgoing_Exchange', ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Student Credit Check'), NOT(Partner_Transcript_Received__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Partner Transcript must be received before advancing to Student Credit Check.
